items.title: By waiving Haywood Highsmith, the Phoenix Suns will drop to $7.9M under their second-apron hard cap.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
By waiving Haywood Highsmith, the Phoenix Suns will drop to $7.9M under their second-apron hard cap.

Phoenix is also keeping Duop Reath by converting him to a two-way contract. That will necessitate a waiver of one of the team's current two-way players.
